audit_result.proof_trace: `syncAllRoles` iterates all members in a `for...of` loop with `await`, issuing O(N × roles_per_member) Discord REST calls (getMember + up to 7 add/remove role ops per member) with no throttle, sleep, semaphore, or queue-depth cap anywhere in the function or discord utils. discord.js's internal 429 handler prevents permanent Discord-side rate limit violations but does not bound the rate of calls enqueued — repeated invocations or large member counts saturate discord.js's REST queue, delaying all concurrent bot Discord operations.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An attacker with the static `API_AUTH_TOKEN` repeatedly POSTs to `/api/roles/sync-all`; each call enqueues hundreds of Discord REST requests causing discord.js queue saturation and degrading all other bot Discord operations until the backlog clears.

PROP-stem-bot-v21-inv-010.text: syncAllRoles must rate-limit Discord API calls to prevent rate limit exhaustion.
